contracts.name: RunStatus
contracts.description: Agent run lifecycle status: created | running | waiting_hitl | completed | failed | cancelled.

contracts.name: SchedulerResult
contracts.description: Result of a scheduled graph run: final status, channels, node history, error, output, and HITL interrupt when waiting_hitl.

contracts.name: CompiledGraph
contracts.description: Immutable compile output consumed by the scheduler: validated graph with precomputed adjacency, terminals, and entry node.

contracts.name: GraphDefinition
contracts.description: Authoring-time graph definition: nodes, edges, optional graphId/entryNodeId. Input to compileGraph.

contracts.name: HitlDecision
contracts.description: Human decision payload for HITL resume: action string, optional data, decidedAt ISO timestamp.

contracts.name: RunView
contracts.description: Run snapshot from ControlPlane.getRun: run metadata plus ordered event trace.

contracts.name: EventRow
contracts.description: A single trace event row: runId, seq, eventType (node_start/node_end/tool_call/checkpoint/hitl/run_started/run_completed/run_failed/run_cancelled), payload, createdAt.

contracts.name: StateStore
contracts.description: Persistence interface for agent-runtime: runs, node executions, checkpoints, tool calls, events, HITL interrupts. Implemented by SQLiteStateStore.

contracts.name: ToolExecutionResult
contracts.description: Output of a tool execution: toolName, input, output, status (completed/failed/timeout/cancelled/error), durationMs, attempt, idempotencyKey and error info.
